scenes.name: Planet to market
scenes.description: A broad desert-region view establishes the settlement, roads and mine before cutting into marketplace life and the partners’ plan.

scenes.name: The diversion and theft
scenes.description: Harper draws attention while Taffy takes the key.

scenes.name: Separate escapes
scenes.description: Harper casually withdraws; broker orders pursuit; she dodges behind shade past Wedge while Taffy takes the high route.

scenes.name: Blue-pipe reunion
scenes.description: The partners reconnect beneath the blue pipe.

scenes.name: Relay entrance
scenes.description: They use the key at the controlled entrance while an ongoing news report is visible inside.

scenes.name: The news report
scenes.description: The partners recognize the distant depot theft footage and realize they were observed; bystanders cannot clearly identify their faces.
